a.lede: CEO of Cambridge-based firm viewed as leading contender to replace co-founder Jensen Huang according to reports Business live – latest updates Nvidia’s headhunters have reportedly approached the chief executive of the Cambridge-based chip company Arm, in its search for a new leader after Jensen Huang’s dramatic exit. Heidrick & Struggles, the recruiting firm hired by the company’s board, has started
a.title: Nvidia approaches Arm boss Rene Haas in search for new CEO

b.lede: Huang said in a statement that he “would be honored” to return as Nvidia CEO if the board of directors supported the decision.
b.title: Jensen Huang Says He’s Open to Coming Back to Nvidia
